ety.text: Borrowed from French caféine, from café (“coffee”), or German Caffein, Kaffein (cp. Coffein, Koffein), from Kaffee (“coffee”) (cp. Kaffe, Koffee, Koffe), or Italian caffè (“coffee”) + -ine.

senses.d: An alkaloid, C₈H₁₀N₄O₂, found naturally in tea and coffee plants, which acts as a mild stimulant on the central nervous system.
ex: For example, 0.100 grams of caffeine yield by combustion, by weight, 0.180 grammes of carbonic acid.

grp.label: alkaloid found naturally in tea and coffee plants
